## Phase 0: Scope, source and readiness

1. Record the source path/revision and new sibling path. Keep the original intact.
2. Confirm {{AUDIENCE_SCOPE_PROFILE_AND_EXCLUSIONS}}.
3. Assign source, integration, security, delivery and cost owners.
4. Verify target environment/harness, roles, approved model, data policy,
   channel support and current Copilot Credit requirements from official sources.
5. Record `[VERIFY]`/`[FILL]` gates with owners and exit criteria outside runtime skills.

## Phase 1: Sources and integrations

{{SOURCE_SPECIFIC_SETUP_STEPS_AND_OFFICIAL_REFERENCES}}

Validate source readiness, permission trimming, citations and freshness as permitted
and denied non-maker users. For tools, implement/configure only the operations in
the [matrix](0.Resources/Capability-matrix.md), bind the intended caller, and exercise
errors and action boundaries before enabling them. Mark proposed contracts as such.
Do not equate knowledge ingestion with a live record feed.

## Phase 2: Create a new GHCP agent

1. In Copilot Studio, use Home > Agent or Agents > New agent and select the GHCP
   experience. Name the agent and review Agent settings before the first save.
2. Enter scenario-specific global instructions, then save.
3. Add validated knowledge through Build > Knowledge. Add actual approved tools
   through Build > Tools when needed; configure authentication and selected actions.
4. Choose an approved model, memory policy and authentication appropriate to the
   scenario. Validate actual supported controls rather than copying old settings.

### Global instructions

```text
{{COMPLETE_AGENT_ROLE_SCOPE_GROUNDING_LANGUAGE_SKILL_SELECTION_AND_FAILURE_RULES}}
```

Keep hard safety and scope boundaries global so they apply even without skill activation.

## Phase 3: Add runtime skills

1. Open Build > Skills > Add skill > Upload a skill.
2. Upload each standalone SKILL.md linked in [Skills](0.Resources/Skills/README.md).
   If a skill needs assets, upload a ZIP containing SKILL.md and all referenced assets.
3. Inspect names, descriptions and instructions. For Create from blank, put YAML
   values in Name/Description and the Markdown body in Instructions. For Generate
   with AI, review before Add to agent.
4. Preview matching, non-matching and compound requests; inspect available execution
   details rather than assuming a response proves that a skill loaded.

## Phase 4: End-to-end acceptance

{{SCENARIO_SPECIFIC_COMPOSED_EXAMPLE_WITH_EXACT_CAPABILITY_SEQUENCE}}

| Case | Expected observable result | Release gate |
|---|---|---|
| {{POSITIVE_CASE}} | {{EVIDENCE_OR_ACTION_RESULT}} | {{CRITERION}} |
| Required capability OFF | Stop dependent work, preserve valid earlier results | No alternate API bypass |
| Denied or unavailable source | Explicit limitation without restricted disclosure | No fabricated evidence |
| Partial/failed/pending step | Distinguish actual outcomes; reconcile uncertain writes | No false success or duplicates |

Use [Sample prompts](4.Sample-prompts.md); repeat representative tests across fresh
conversations, identities and languages. Record actual outcomes separately from expectations.

## Phase 5: Pilot, publish, monitor and rollback

{{CURRENT_HOST_SPECIFIC_PUBLISH_GUIDANCE_AND_APPROVED_CHANNEL}}

Only publish after acceptance and owner approval. Pilot a restricted audience,
monitor quality/cost/source health and record configuration versions. Keep the source
agent available. Roll back the GHCP audience/version and coordinate tool/backend
disablement; do not remove shared connections needed by the original.
